name: Amaike Shizuko
source:
Shizuko is the caretaker of a certain church on the island, as well as the one in-charge of the female side of the school dormitory. She is always wearing a sister outfit. Her Christian name is "Margarita", while most students address her as "Sister Amaike" instead. She is typically sister-like and a no-nonsense type of person most of the time, however she is also known to be very scary when she loses her temper. [url=/c1185]Kouhei[/url] fears her as "The Person who cannot take jokes". [url=/c1187]Kanade[/url] calls her "Maru-chan" and [url=/c1198]Iori[/url] calls her "Shizuko-chan", which she doesn't seem too happy about.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fortune_Arterial]Wikipedia[/url].]
